topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I was scrolling through the college's website, idly looking at examples of successful application essays. It was supposed to be a quick browse, a way to distract myself for a few minutes. But then, I paused, my eyes fixating on one particular essay. The words, the way they were woven together, the voice behind them—it was unmistakably mine. My essay. The one I spent countless nights perfecting, pouring so much of myself into. There it was, displayed for everyone to see, a piece of me I never intended to share so openly. I felt a heaviness in my chest, as if someone had turned the volume down on the world around me. All I wanted was to be left alone, to retreat into the silence.
